Strings.Settings.AppearanceDescription: Interface language, colors and message borders
Strings.Settings.MessageBordersHelp: Set SC, gift and guard border thickness independently from 0.5 to 10. Larger values make thicker borders. Changes apply after saving.
Strings.Settings.InvalidMessageBorderThickness: Enter a border thickness between 0.5 and 10 for each message type.
Strings.Settings.BacklogHelp: Real-time mode prioritizes Super Chats and pinned messages, skipping ordinary tasks beyond 200 queued items or 30 seconds. Queue-all mode saves pending work and resumes after restart.
Strings.Settings.BaseUrlHelp: Choose a provider, or select Custom to enter a URL. Custom services must support OpenAI Chat Completions; use a base URL or a full /chat/completions URL.
Strings.Settings.CacheSizeHelp: Total file size of avatars, emoticons and translation caches. Message history is excluded.
Strings.Settings.OpenDataDirectoryFailed: Unable to open the data directory.
Strings.Settings.CacheHelp: Translations are reused for identical text and target language across API, model, prompt and glossary changes. Clearing the cache affects future translations and keeps translations saved with messages. Retranslate individual messages to update saved translations.
Strings.Settings.ComboNewValue: Unread when new value reaches threshold
Strings.Settings.AutoScrollLongMessagesHelp: Long single-line text scrolls to the end and repeats. Wrapped text stays still. Hover scrolling remains available when disabled.
Strings.Settings.HideEmoticonDanmuHelp: Hide ordinary danmu containing only emoticons. Messages with text remain visible. Turn off to show them again.
Strings.Settings.BlockingDescription: Set display and translation blocking for each danmu rule
Strings.Settings.DanmuRegexRulesHelp: Choose blocking options for each rule. A rule with both options off has no effect. Full blocking takes priority. Rules apply only to ordinary danmu and take effect when saved.
Strings.Settings.DanmuRegexBlockDisplayHelp: Ordinary danmu matching this rule is hidden and is not translated.
Strings.Settings.DanmuRegexBlockTranslationHelp: Ordinary danmu matching this rule keeps its original text and is not translated. If Block all is also selected, the danmu is hidden.
Strings.Settings.DanmuRegexInvalidPattern: Blocking rule {0} is invalid. Correct or remove it before saving.
Strings.Settings.DanmuRegexTimedOut: Danmu blocking pattern {0} timed out and has been suspended. Edit the pattern and save settings again.
Strings.Settings.DataDescription: Settings backup, message history and local caches
Strings.Settings.TransferHelp: Back up or share appearance, reading, translation (including the glossary) and update preferences. Accounts, workspaces, layouts and message history are excluded.
Strings.Settings.TransferKeyHelp: Exported files retain the full API key. Sharing a file also shares its key.
Strings.Settings.ImportConfirm: The file's global settings, including its API key, will replace your current settings and unsaved settings drafts. After a successful import, they take effect immediately and this window closes. Account name edits will still be saved. Continue?
Strings.Settings.ExportFailed: Could not export settings. Please retry
Strings.Settings.ImportFailed: Could not import settings. Please retry
Strings.Settings.ImportRestoreFailed: Import failed. Your previous settings were restored in memory but could not be saved again. Check file permissions and retry.

Strings.Settings.GiftPinyin: Show tonal Pinyin for Chinese gift names
Strings.Settings.HistoryHelp: Messages, translations, pins and read states are saved continuously. Clearing history removes records in the chosen scope while keeping accounts, settings and layouts.
Strings.Settings.IncompleteTerm: Enter a source term and a translation in at least one language for each glossary entry.
Strings.Settings.InvalidTranslation: Enter a valid API URL, model name and target language.
Strings.Settings.MessageSortingHelp: Choose separate unread and read orders for SC, gifts and memberships. Panels start at the top when opened or switched.
Strings.Settings.InvalidMessageSortOrder: Choose valid unread and read orders for each panel.
Strings.Settings.ShowUserAvatarsHelp: Show round avatars to the left of names in all messages, with local caching and automatic updates.
Strings.Settings.ShowFanMedalsHelp: Show fan medals in danmaku. Turning this off also hides the “None” placeholder and collapses the medal column.
Strings.Settings.MessageRetentionCountHelp: Number of recent records shown by default in each message panel, initially 300. Pinned and priority unread messages are shown in addition. Reading history keeps the current records, and earlier history can still be loaded.
Strings.Settings.InvalidMessageRetentionCount: Enter a whole number from 1 to {0} for messages to retain.
Strings.Settings.DanmuPinyin: Show tonal Pinyin for chat message text
Strings.Settings.SuperChatPinyin: Show tonal Pinyin for SC text
Strings.Settings.MessageTextScaleHelp: Scale text uniformly across the chat, SC, gift, membership, and red pocket panels.
Strings.Settings.PinyinHelp: Pinyin is generated locally without translation requests. Characters with multiple pronunciations use dictionary readings. Usernames, gift names, chat messages, and SC share the layout. Hover over an annotated Chinese character to highlight its syllable.
Strings.Settings.PinyinScrollHelp: When a single line of annotations exceeds the available width, scroll horizontally or hold Shift while scrolling to view the rest.
Strings.Settings.ReadingDescription: Message display, gift read behavior, and Pinyin
